videos.caption: I started this page over a year ago, but a big project arrived in the meantime and it ended up waiting much longer than I originally planned. ☺️ I finally came back to it and finished it recently, and I'm so glad I did. This page became a real mixed media experiment, combining acrylic markers, colored pencils, watercolors, and these beautiful metallic paints from Panophobia Colors that gave almost the entire page a soft old-gold shimmer 🥰 I filmed the whole process along the way, and although it's not a real-time tutorial, I think you can still clearly see how I approached the different elements and built up the layers. If you'd like to see the full coloring process, the video is now available on my YouTube channel, Black Aneri. 💛 Coloring Book: Johanna Basford - Worlds of Wonder #johannabasford #worldsofwonder #blackaneri_johannabasford #mixedmediaart #mixedmediacoloring
